events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy icon John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: John Cleese is 87 today! The man behind some of Britain's most iconic comedy moments, from dead parrots to wobbly hotels. What's your favourite Cleese classic?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released in 1968
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album,' was released in 1968, featuring a diverse range of tracks.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles gave us the 'White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece that proved they could do anything. Which track is on your playlist today?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who died in 1991.

angles.name: A True Legend
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who left us on this day in 1991. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. Play a Queen track loud for Freddie.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released in 1965
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in 1965, marking a significant shift in their musical style.

angles.name: A Soulful Shift
angles.copy: 59 years ago, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. The album that showed us a new, more introspective side of the Fab Four. Still sounds brilliant today.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic death of The Beatles legend John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who we lost on this day in 1980. His message of peace and love resonates as strongly as ever. A true musical visionary.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Visionary artist David Bowie, who passed away in 2016, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Starman's 80th
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. An artist who constantly reinvented himself and left an indelible mark on music and culture. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away in 1977, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. The King still reigns supreme!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's iconic sound and one of rock's greatest guitarists. What's your favourite Page riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the iconic British singer known for his distinctive raspy voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the legendary Sir Rod Stewart! Still rocking and charming audiences worldwide. What's your go-to Rod Stewart anthem?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness Maestro
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the voice of Madness! From Camden Town to global stages, he's given us so many unforgettable tunes. Which Madness track gets you skanking?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer Paul Young, known for his blue-eyed soul hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat,' celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Blue-Eyed Soulman
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! The smooth voice behind some of the 80s' biggest hits. Which one always takes you back?

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Country music legend Dolly Parton, who passed away in August 2026, would have celebrated her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Tribute to a Queen
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Dolly Parton, who would have been 81 today. Her music, her heart, her spirit – truly one of a kind. What's your favourite Dolly song?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Pop Maestro
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That anthems to solo success, he's written the soundtrack to so many lives. What's your ultimate Barlow track?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s soul and R&B hits, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the smooth-voiced Billy Ocean! 'Caribbean Queen,' 'When the Going Gets Tough' – pure 80s gold. What's your favourite?

events.title: First Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame induction ceremony (1989)
events.blurb: The inaugural Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame induction ceremony was held on this day in 1989, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its first induction ceremony. A monumental moment for music history! Who would you induct today?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen, known for his distinctive vocals and solo career, celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! One quarter of Take That and a solo artist in his own right. What's your favourite Mark Owen moment?

events.title: The Beatles' famous rooftop concert (1969)
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary impromptu rooftop concert on Savile Row, their final public performance.

angles.name: Rooftop Rockers
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert. The last time they played live together. What a moment!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Grammy-winning singer, drummer, and songwriter Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Drummer & Hitmaker
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! A drumming powerhouse and a voice behind countless hits. What's your favourite Phil Collins track, solo or Genesis?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar, singer, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Prince of Pop
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to Justin Timberlake! From boyband heartthrob to solo sensation, he truly does it all. What's your top JT tune?

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason, known for his iconic roles as Del Boy and Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: National Treasure
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the one and only Sir David Jason! A true national treasure who has brought us so much joy. What's your favourite David Jason character?

events.title: Anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died' (1959)
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died,' when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash in 1959.

angles.name: Remembering Legends
angles.copy: 68 years ago today, rock and roll lost three stars: Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper. 'The Day The Music Died' still echoes. Which of their songs means the most to you?

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Rick Astley, famous for his 80s hits and viral 'Rickrolling' phenomenon, celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to Rick Astley! The voice behind an 80s anthem and an internet legend. What's your favourite Rick Astley track?

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae legend Bob Marley, who passed away in 1981, would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love, One Heart
angles.copy: On what would have been his 82nd birthday, we're celebrating the enduring spirit and music of Bob Marley. His message of unity and peace lives on.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Grammy-winning singer-songwriter Carole King, a true music legend, celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Tapestry of Hits
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the phenomenal Carole King! A songwriting genius who gave us 'Tapestry' and countless classics. What's your favourite Carole King song?

events.title: Anniversary of Whitney Houston's death
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of global superstar Whitney Houston, who died in 2012.

angles.name: The Voice Remembered
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible Whitney Houston, who we lost on this day in 2012. Her voice was truly one of a kind and continues to inspire. What's your favourite Whitney ballad?
